verdict.rationale: The API covers the core runtime loop: creating applicants, starting workflow runs that return SDK tokens, retrieving results via webhooks or polling, and OAuth client-credentials authentication. However, configuration surfaces are documented only in the UI: workflows are built in the no-code Workflow Studio, and accepted documents are set in the Dashboard. Nothing shows these can be managed programmatically. Missing for 10: API-level workflow creation and editing, API for Dashboard configuration such as document-acceptance filters, and an explicit statement or independent confirmation of API/UI parity.
